sentenceSets.sentence: It took months to assimilate the full implications of the discovery, so radical were they.

answerChoices.reasoning: While 'understand' means to comprehend, the sentence emphasizes thoroughly taking in and integrating ('assimilate') the implications over time.
'Comprehend' means to grasp mentally; while he comprehends, 'assimilate' emphasizes the thorough internal integration over months.
'Grasp' means to understand; while he grasps, 'assimilate' emphasizes the thorough integration into understanding.
'Realize' means to become aware; while he realizes, 'assimilate' emphasizes thoroughly taking in and integrating the implications.
'Accept' means to agree to or take; while he accepts, 'assimilate' emphasizes thoroughly understanding and integrating.
'Internalize' means to make part of oneself; while closely related, 'assimilate' emphasizes thorough mental understanding.
'Absorb' means to take in; while he absorbs, 'assimilate' emphasizes thorough integration into understanding.
'Digest' means to think over and understand; while he digests, 'assimilate' emphasizes thorough integration.
Rejected means to refuse or discard; it contradicts taking in and thoroughly understanding the implications.
Ignored means to disregard; it contradicts the thorough mental integration of the implications.
Dismissed means to refuse consideration; it contradicts thoroughly taking in and understanding.

'Memorize' means to commit to memory; while they memorize, the sentence emphasizes assimilating (thoroughly understanding) the information.
'Absorb' means to take in; while they absorb, 'assimilate' emphasizes thorough integration into understanding.
'Grasp' means to understand; while they grasp, 'assimilate' emphasizes thorough integration and comprehension.
'Study' means to examine carefully; while they study, 'assimilate' emphasizes thorough integration into understanding.
'Comprehend' means to understand; while they comprehend, 'assimilate' emphasizes thorough integration over time.
'Process' means to handle or deal with; while they process information, 'assimilate' emphasizes thorough mental integration.
'Internalize' means to make part of oneself; though related, 'assimilate' emphasizes taking in and thoroughly understanding.
Ignored means to disregard; it contradicts the effort to thoroughly understand and integrate information.
Dismissed means to refuse consideration; it contradicts taking in and thoroughly integrating information.
Rejected means to refuse; it contradicts thoroughly taking in and understanding the information.

'Accept' means to agree to or take; while they accept, 'assimilate' emphasizes thorough integration into understanding and behavior.
'Adapt' means to adjust; while they adapt, 'assimilate' emphasizes thorough integration into understanding.
'Internalize' means to make part of oneself; while related, 'assimilate' emphasizes taking in and thoroughly understanding.
'Absorb' means to take in; while they absorb norms, 'assimilate' emphasizes thorough integration.
'Grasp' means to understand; while they grasp norms, 'assimilate' emphasizes thorough integration.
